messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a canary for r2041 in tonight's change window (02:00 UTC). Need approvals for traffic split + transient quota bump. Plan: 5% -> 25% over 30m, guard: p99 < 200ms AND error-rate < 0.5%. Please ack by 01:30.

deploy-bot: rollout created: /rollouts r2041-canary (requires 1 approver). Traffic: v2=5%. Schedule: 2027-06-15T02:00Z. Console: https://console.redwood/r/rollouts/r2041-canary

sam: on it. quick q — does this need a quota bump? current model.qps = 120, estimated +40 qps for canary.

maria: yes, request transient quota bump to 200 qps for model.r2041 for the window. Ops to approve.

ryan: ops can do transient bump if risk is low. share the telemetry dashboard + expected tokens/sec so we can make decision.

maria: dashboard + perf estimates attached to rollout. snippet of rollout config: 
```
{"traffic": [{"variant": "v2", "pct": 5}], "guards": [{"metric": "p99_latency_ms", "op": "<", "value": 200}, {"metric": "error_rate_pct", "op": "<", "value": 0.5}], "ramp": {"to": 25, "duration_min": 30}}
```

jess: looks reasonable. suggestion: add fallback:true so requests automatically use v1 if guard trips. also add a warmup=true flag for KV cache.

ryan: noted — warmup flag is important. otherwise first 5m could show high p99. ops needs the exact window times for the transient bump.

ops-bot: ops-bot: transient quota bump scheduled: model.r2041 -> qps 200 for 2027-06-15T02:00:00Z to 2027-06-15T02:45:00Z. ticket OPS-3421.

sam: approved. @deploy-bot proceed once bump is active. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: approval received from sam. initiating canary in 10m. Applying 5% traffic to v2 now.

monitoring-bot: canary r2041:v2 initial metrics (first 5m): p50=38ms, p95=120ms, p99=190ms, error_rate=0.12%. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/graphs/r2041-canary

jess: observability looks good. I'll hold manual ramp to 25% until 30m mark and review the 20m window.

sam: agreed. if p99 < 210ms and error < 0.5% after 20m, plan to auto-ramp to 25% over 10m.

monitoring-bot: anomalous spike detected at +22m: r2041:v2 error_rate increased to 1.6% (5m rolling). Guard threshold breached.

deploy-bot: guard triggered (error_rate > 1%). Rolling back v2 -> 0% per policy and routing fallback to v1. Rollback completed. Notifying owners.

maria: thanks for the quick rollback. please capture logs/traces for the window and open a follow-up issue. I'll triage — postmortem if needed.

ryan: grabbing traces and KV-hit stats now. early look: spike concentrated on requests with long context + rare token pattern, might be a regression in model preprocessing.

maria: ok reassign to model-onboarding for a patch run. we'll re-schedule canary after fix. closing the window for this deploy.
